run.name: OPENLANE, Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (OPLN)
run.summary: OPENLANE has a sound corporate credit profile, with total debt at 1.43x LTM Adjusted EBITDA and liquidity of USD 650.2 million, but most funding is receivable-backed securitization and its performance decides the credit. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA (company definition), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Total debt 545.9 over LTM Adjusted EBITDA 382.7; cash and cash equivalents 244.9. The company reports a covenant ratio of 0.9 on its own definition. Securitization obligations of 2,084.4 gross are excluded because Adjusted EBITDA already deducts securitization interest. Calculated.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM EBITDA 451.5 over LTM cash interest 132.1. EBITDA here is before the securitization-interest deduction that Adjusted EBITDA makes, which matches cash interest that includes securitization interest. On Adjusted EBITDA the ratio is 2.90. Calculated.

cash.basis: Cash. Same basis; restricted cash of 34.7 excluded. Excludes the securitization committed capacity (US$2.0 billion and C$500 million), whose undrawn amount is Not calculable from the pack, and the European lines of 45.3, which the filing does not call committed. Both revolvers mature June 23, 2028. As printed.

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: The credit and securitization agreements are not supplied, so covenant terms and undrawn securitization capacity are unverified.
CP-1 main limitation: The credit agreement and securitization agreements are not supplied, so covenant definitions and undrawn securitization capacity cannot be tested.
